blockingFindings.title: Missing non-empty findings array coverage
blockingFindings.issue: R5 requires spec-local tests to verify the required override artifact fields, and R2 defines the findings array as non-empty. The test only matches /findings\[\]/, so guidance that mentions a findings array but omits the non-empty requirement would still pass.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local assertion that the prompt documents the findings array must be non-empty.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local test coverage for a required override artifact constraint.

blockingFindings.title: Accepted-risk audit trail guidance is under-specified in the test
blockingFindings.issue: R5 requires verification of accepted_risk audit/task guidance, but the test only checks for accepted_risk and /issue-log|related task/i separately. It would pass text that mentions issue-log somewhere without stating that accepted_risk recovery needs an audit or task trail using the TOOLING_FAILURE entry or an explicit related task reference.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add assertions that tie accepted_risk recovery to an audit/task trail and to either the existing issue-log TOOLING_FAILURE entry or an explicit related task reference.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A required recovery condition can be omitted while the test still passes, leaving a critical requirement uncovered.
